{{short description|Danish mathematician}}
[[File:Christoffer Dybvad Decarithmia 01.jpeg|thumb|right|300px|"Decarithmia. Ded er Thinde-Regnskab" (1602)]]

'''Christoffer Dybvad''' (1578–1622) was a [[Danish people|Danish]] [[mathematician]]. He was born in [[Copenhagen]], the son of Professor [[Jørgen Dybvad]].<ref>[https://runeberg.org/dbl/4/0375.html Dansk biografisk Lexikon / IV. Bind. Clemens - Eynden /] accessed 27 September 2011</ref>

He adapted [[Simon Stevin]]'s ''De Thiende'' into [[Danish language|Danish]].<ref>[http://home.wxs.nl/~hopfam/StevinEngels.html Simon Stevin (1548-1620)] accessed 27 September 2011</ref>
